title: nostr-relay: implement OpenAgents discovery, privacy, and retention profiles
body:
Add the relay-side contracts for revised/new OpenAgents profiles while keeping execution admission in hosts. Generic event storage is not full profile conformance.

Specifications: [nips/openagents/README.md](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/nips/openagents/README.md), [nips/openagents/NIP-CAP.md](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/nips/openagents/NIP-CAP.md), [nips/openagents/NIP-PRG.md](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/nips/openagents/NIP-PRG.md), [nips/openagents/NIP-EXT.md](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/nips/openagents/NIP-EXT.md), [nips/openagents/NIP-RUN.md](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/nips/openagents/NIP-RUN.md).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Implement validated public CAP/PRG/EXT definitions and discovery with portable single-letter t/x/e tags; document role-specific indexed queries.
- [ ] Implement private CAP policy and RUN envelope admission, NIP-42 author publication, exact author/recipient read ACLs, and exclusions across REQ, IDs, COUNT, search, and live fanout.
- [ ] Implement regular release/revocation/run-record retention and addressable heads without treating replacement, relay acknowledgment, or EOSE as execution or completeness evidence.
- [ ] Validate kind/version/shape boundaries, body/tag consistency where plaintext is available, and configured size/rate/retention limits. Never pretend to validate encrypted program contents.
- [ ] Use the existing binary/Postgres architecture, atomic policy/store paths, backup/restore, and cross-process visibility; introduce no private parallel service.
- [ ] Advertise nip-cap-v1, nip-prg-v1, nip-ext-v1, and nip-run-v1 only for proven configured roles. Add public/private adversarial Postgres acceptance and operational retention documentation.

## Boundaries and dependencies

New-protocol prerequisites: #9516, #9517, #9518, #9520, #9521.

Product code stays Rust. Use the shared crates and existing authority boundaries. Protocol text is the target; this issue is not complete until implementation and conformance evidence exist. Run checks appropriate to implementation changes, manually or on non-GitHub infrastructure.
